## AI platform: tokens and cost by team
Token numbers come from the `llm-emit-token-metric` policy on the API gateway (week 4). Cost is an **estimate**: set your model's current prices in the boxes below. If the tables are empty, run the last query to see which metric names your gateway emits.

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Total Tokens")
| extend team = tostring(customDimensions["Team"])
| summarize tokens = sum(valueSum) by team, name
| evaluate pivot(name, sum(tokens))
content.title: Tokens by team

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name == "Total Tokens"
| extend team = tostring(customDimensions["Team"])
| summarize tokens = sum(valueSum) by team, bin(timestamp, 1h)
content.title: Total tokens per hour by team
Estimated cost by team (showback)

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize calls = count() by resultCode
| order by calls desc
content.title: Gateway responses by status code (429 = token limit, 401/403 = blocked)

content.query:
customMetrics
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| summarize samples = count() by name
| order by samples desc
content.title: Which token metric names does my gateway emit?
